description: Per-panel overrides for the gallery sweep (perf/runner/gallery-sweep.mjs). A panel needs none unless a control's accessible name is ambiguous, or it runs on a clock that has to be advanced by hand. `before_build` is evaluated in the page before the panel is first selected, `advance` after every click and once more at the end, and `next`, `previous` and `restart` are regular expressions for the accessible name of a control, used instead of the defaults. `skip` names a reason to leave the panel out of the walk and still load and revisit it.

panel-tarjan.skip: the panel only opens the demo in its own window, and has no controls of its own to walk
